fun_facts: Evan McPherson is from Fort Payne, Alabama.
At Florida, Evan McPherson made 51 of 60 field-goal tries (85%) across three seasons.
One of Evan McPherson’s nicknames is “Shooter.”
In his rookie season, Evan McPherson made 12 field goals from 50 or more yards—then an NFL record—and five game-winning field goals.
As a rookie, Evan McPherson kicked the winning field goals in both the AFC Divisional Round and the AFC Championship Game.

The Cincinnati Bengals were the only team to draft a kicker in 2021.

The Bengals selected Florida placekicker [Evan McPherson](https://www.nfl.com/players/evan-mcpherson) with the 149th overall selection in the fifth round.

McPherson spent three years with the Gators, connecting on 85% of his field-goal attempts, going 51-of-60 overall. He also made 94.5% of his boots inside 40 yards during his career.

Kicker [Evan McPherson](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4360234/evan-mcpherson) has agreed to terms on a three-year extension worth $16.5 million, a source confirmed to ESPN. McPherson, a fifth-round draft pick in 2021, was in the final year of his rookie contact.

The former Florida standout was an integral piece of Cincinnati's best playoff run in 33 years. As a rookie, he hit the winning field goals in the AFC divisional round of the 2021 playoffs and the AFC championship game against Kansas City.
